integrity: The all-dimension statement is proved algebraically. The bundled exact-rational replay is a consistency check, not a substitute for the proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for deterministic unconstrained PolyakEG on finite-dimensional skew-isometric linear operators; not a worst-case statement for all monotone operators, non-isometric skew maps, constraints, or stochastic variants.
title: Exact variable-step PolyakEG law on skew-isometric monotone operators
